mentions.name: Elizabeth Line Guide
mentions.description: A website for quickly looking up fares and timetables for the Elizabeth Line in London between any two stations, built as an experiment using AI tooling.
mentions.problem: Getting fares and timetables for the Elizabeth Line in London between two stations quickly was difficult.
mentions.source_excerpt: I found it hard to get fares and timetables for the Elizabeth Line in London between X and Y quickly hence I built this as an experiment using AI tooling.
mentions.author: ahallan
